facebook.manual_input_post: We're growing-and we're proud to share a major step forward. We now have a permanent location at 321 Theis Rd., Sewell, NJ, where we're honored to share space with VFW Post 6332 and American Legion Post 521 in the former Washington Township firehouse. We are deeply grateful to the Township of Washington for this opportunity. Thank you to our community for the continued support, and to our Mayor, Chief of the Fire Department, Chief of Police, and our council members for standing with us. You'll also begin hearing us on the radio (1210 AM), made possible by our friends and supporters, the Pantano family. We also extend our condolences to Bob and his family on the passing of his wife's father, a proud WWII veteran. We will be honoring his service on our website as we continue to grow. Stay tuned for upcoming events-our next major one is our 5K on Saturday, August 8th. Registration opens at 7:00 AM, with a start time expected around 8:15 AM. Thank you all. If you're able, please consider supporting us through the donation tab on our website.
